# Draft:President Cory C. Aquino Boulevard

----
President Corazon C. Aquino Boulevard (Cory C. Aquino Boulevard), alternatively known as Bagasbas Boulevard is an 8.7 kilometers boulevard connecting the municipalities of Mercedes, Daet, Talisay and Vinzons in Camarines Norte. The largest part of it is located in Barangay Bagasbas, a coastal barangay in Camarines Norte.
The boulevard is the longest boulevard Philippines. It was formerly called as Bagasbas Boulevard, but it was later renamed after the late president, Corazon C. Aquino.
The boulevard is also known for its food trucks and caravans, especially during nighttime.
Route description
Currently, Cory C. Aquino Boulevard begins at Delos Reyes Boulevard in Mercedes, Camarines Norte, to the south, and extends northward to Calangkawan Sur Road in Vinzons, Camarines Norte. A bridge is being constructed to connect the boulevard further north.
Key structures
* Sabangan Beach, Mercedes, Camarines Norte
* Centennial Wharf, Daet, Camarines Norte
* Bagasbas Airport, Daet, Camarines Norte
* Bagasbas Lighthouse, Daet, Camarines Norte
* San Jose Beach, Talisay, Camarines Norte
